ConnectionStrings._DefaultConnection: PostgreSQL. Supplied at runtime via ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection, or user-secrets in development. Never commit a real connection string here - it contains the password.

Jwt._Key: Supplied at runtime via the Jwt__Key environment variable. Never commit a real key here - see appsettings.Development.json for the local-only value.
Jwt._IssuerAudience: Deliberately still IAMS.* after the AssetDesk rename. These are validated on every request (ValidateIssuer/ValidateAudience in Program.cs) and production sets its own values, so changing them invalidates every token already issued. Rename only alongside a deploy that rotates them everywhere at once.

_App: WebUrl is the origin of the Blazor client, and is what password-reset links in email point at - it must match where AssetDesk.Web actually runs (see src/AssetDesk.Web/Properties/launchSettings.json) or every reset link is dead. Override both per environment.
